claude.rationale: The slice states this was a whole-company reverse-triangular take-private in which "the customer-facing product (IME services), the operational processes that deliver it (the medical panel and service operations), and the operating legal entity transferred together as a single going concern," with no carve-out or divestiture at closing — so product and process moved together (gap_45=0). Senior management (Perlman, Price, Campbell, Fernandez de Castro) continued in their current positions via a rollover-and-subscription agreement, so the people running the processes crossed the boundary alongside them (gap_56=0). T1 is coded imprint-share because Leonard Green affiliates control a majority of Parent's equity/board while rollover founders retained ~3.3–3.7% and continuing roles, leaving both principals' intent co-present at closing.
